findings.reason: The edit removes the _eor-based role-completion assignment from play_iterator.py, but no replacement completion task or strategy handler was added before the run ended. The resulting patch leaves roles without a way to be marked complete and the official play-iterator test failed.

run_review.reason: The final patch changes only play_iterator.py. It removes the existing role-completion mechanism without adding the required implicit meta: role_complete task or strategy handling, leaving the core fix incomplete. The official report also records a failure in test/units/executor/test_play_iterator.py::TestPlayIterator::test_play_iterator.
